entities.description: A silver Apple laptop is open on a wooden table, with its back facing the viewer, displaying the Apple logo. The laptop has a black keyboard and is positioned next to a potted plant and a person holding a smartphone.

An elderly woman with shoulder-length wavy white hair is seated in a wheelchair, wearing a light grey blazer over a pale pink top. She is smiling warmly while looking down at a black smartphone held in her hands, with a silver ring visible on her finger.

accessories.ring: silver band on left ring finger

attributes.action: holding and looking at a smartphone

entities.description: A young man with curly brown hair and a light complexion is smiling broadly while looking down at a smartphone held by an older woman. He is wearing a light pink button-down shirt over a white t-shirt and is seated at a table with a silver laptop in the foreground.

attributes.context: interacting with an older woman holding a phone

entities.description: A close-up view of a light-colored wooden table with a visible grain pattern, featuring a silver laptop and a white potted plant on its surface. A person's hands are visible typing on the laptop, with their arms resting on the table.

A close-up of a white, glossy ceramic or porcelain object, possibly a vase or bottle, with a smooth, curved surface. The background is blurred, showing indistinct shapes and colors, including a hint of brown and black, suggesting an indoor setting with furniture or other objects out of focus.
A close-up, out-of-focus view of a person's shoulder and upper arm on the right side of the frame, with a blurred background featuring horizontal bands of light brown and dark gray.

entities.description: A close-up view of a wheelchair featuring a black, padded armrest attached to a curved, silver metal frame. The armrest has a smooth, rounded top surface and is positioned next to a person wearing a light grey, textured long-sleeved garment. Below the armrest, a portion of a teal or turquoise fabric seat is visible, along with the upper curve of a silver metal wheel rim.
